description: Set up a new multi-account AWS landing zone from scratch using AWS Control Tower. Must: configure AWS Organizations with 3 accounts (audit, shared-services, prod), set up AWS SSO with MFA enforcement, apply guardrails (SCP policies preventing public S3 buckets, restricting regions, enforcing encryption), configure network segmentation (VPCs per account with Transit Gateway), and verify guardrails are enforced. No existing AWS organization. Risk factors: SCP too restrictive blocking legitimate operations, SSO misconfiguration locking out admins, Transit Gateway routing issues. Tools available: AWS Control Tower, terraform, aws CLI, AWS Organizations.
